entry_route.value: A BS in mechanical engineering can go straight to the PhD, or a BS plus MS can be used.
entry_route.quote: Students may apply to the PhD program having completed either a BS degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field (i.e., direct-admit), or a BS and MS degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field.

notes: The Aerospace Engineering and Mechanics PhD (https://catalog.ua.edu/graduate/engineering/aerospace-mechanics/phd/) is a separate department and is not saved as a second record. The department pages me.eng.ua.edu and the graduate handbook PDF returned HTTP 502.
